new.title: Eat Pommes-Currywurst at Wurst Willi
new.desc: Wurst Willi is a long-queued snack bar at the Petrikirchhof in the city centre, with a cult following among Dortmund locals. Its Pommes-Currywurst is the best-selling item.
new.tip: Expect queues at lunchtime; it closes early evening, so go before 20:00.

new.title: Dine in the old pit-pony stable at Pferdestall
new.desc: Restaurant Pferdestall occupies the former stable for the Zollern mine's horses and serves Westphalian cooking with international touches. Its beer garden looks onto the mine buildings and two winding towers.
new.tip: Book a garden table in good weather; combine it with a Zeche Zollern visit.

new.title: Taste Bergmann beer in Hörde's Phoenix West
new.desc: The Bergmann brand was revived in 2006-2007 by Thomas Raphael, and the beer is now brewed at Elias-Bahn-Weg 2 on the former Phoenix West steelworks site in Hörde. Komoot lists the area as a pub and walking destination.
new.tip: Check opening times with the brewery first; pair it with the Phoenix West blast furnaces nearby.

new.title: Drink a Brinkhoff's No.1 at the Alter Markt
new.desc: Brinkhoff's No.1 is a 5.0% Pilsner brewed again since 1977 to a recipe Fritz Brinkhoff developed in 1887. Brinkhoff's No. 1 am Markt, at Markt 6, serves it in the heart of the old town.
new.tip: Open daily from about 11:00 to midnight; sit by the market square.
new.q: Brinkhoff's No. 1 am Markt, Markt 6, 44137 Dortmund

new.title: Dine on the Phoenix See harbour promenade
new.desc: Pfefferkorn Phoenixsee sits at Hafenpromenade 1-2 in Hörde, on the artificial lake completed in 2011. The lakeside promenade is one of the best-known dining addresses in Dortmund.
new.tip: Go on a dry evening for a terrace table, then walk the lake.

new.title: Grill Urfa-style kebab at Mekan Urfa Et Mangal
new.desc: Mekan Urfa Et Mangal at Münsterstraße 47 is a charcoal grill restaurant in the Nordstadt, the district with Dortmund's densest Turkish food scene. It holds a 4.6 rating from about 780 reviews on Wanderlog.
new.tip: Order the mixed grill; Münsterstraße also has other Turkish grills within a few doors.
new.q: Mekan Urfa Et Mangal, Münsterstraße 47, Dortmund

new.title: Have coffee at Grüner Salon on the Nordmarkt
new.desc: Grüner Salon at Nordmarkt 8 is a coffee-focused café on the Nordmarkt square, listed among Dortmund cafés that pick their beans carefully. The square also hosts the big weekly market.
new.tip: Time it with the Tuesday or Friday market and sit on the square.

new.title: Try a specialty coffee at Neues Schwarz
new.desc: Neues Schwarz at Saarlandstraße 33 is a coffee-focused café that Rausgegangen groups with Dortmund cafés choosing their beans by hand.
new.tip: Check current opening hours on the café's own page before you go.

new.title: Eat Westphalian dishes at Mit Schmackes
new.desc: Mit Schmackes at Hohe Straße 61a serves Westphalian food and is listed in Dortmund's Schlemmer-Atlas under German cuisine.
new.tip: Ask for the regional specials of the day.

new.title: Shop the Nordmarkt weekly market
new.desc: A large weekly market has run on the Nordmarkt since the Second World War, on Tuesdays and Fridays. The city calls it the liveliest and most colourful weekly market in Dortmund; its stalls form a ring around the square.
new.tip: Open about 07:00 to 13:00; come on Tuesday or Friday morning.

new.title: Dance at Juicy Beats in the Westfalenpark
new.desc: Juicy Beats is Dortmund's open-air music festival in the Westfalenpark. The 2026 edition was a one-day event on 25 July with four stages, eight floors and about 25,000 visitors.
new.tip: Buy day tickets early; dates for later years are on the festival site.

new.title: Climb indoors at Kletterhalle Bergwerk
new.desc: Kletterhalle Bergwerk is an indoor climbing hall in Dortmund-Huckarde with a separate children's bouldering area, according to visitor reviews.
new.tip: Good for a rainy day; check the hall's site for prices and gear hire.

new.title: Boulder year-round at Boulderwelt Dortmund
new.desc: Boulderwelt Dortmund is an indoor bouldering hall open all year, listed in Ruhr-area leisure guides.
new.tip: Beginners can rent shoes; check the site for day-pass prices.

new.title: Hear live jazz at the Domicil club
new.desc: Domicil, run by the non-profit domicil Dortmund e.V., has a main hall and a club room at Hansastraße 7-11. It hosts the Jazztage Dortmund and the Projazz Festival.
new.tip: Autumn and winter Jazztage concerts run into December; book through the club.

new.title: See a gig at the FZW
new.desc: FZW is a Dortmund concert venue established in 1968, with a main hall for about 1,000 and a club room for 300.
new.tip: Check the programme on the FZW site; concerts are mostly in the evening.

new.title: Climb the Asselner Alm for a Dortmund panorama
new.desc: Halde Schleswig, the former spoil heap of Zeche Schleswig in Asseln, is about 45 metres high and 35 hectares in area. It opened to the public on 5 June 2024 and gives views over Dortmund and the airport.
new.tip: Entrances at Aplerbecker Straße 101 and Neuhammerweg; keep dogs on a lead because of ground-nesting birds.

new.title: Eat currywurst at the Bratwursthaus
new.desc: The Bratwursthaus at Kortumstraße 18 in central Bochum serves bratwurst variations and currywurst with Ruhrpott flair, and shows currywurst as a featured dish.
new.tip: Open in the Bermuda3Eck area; check hours on the website.

new.title: Tour the Moritz Fiege brewery and taste the Zwickel
new.desc: Privatbrauerei Moritz Fiege has brewed in central Bochum since 1878. The BrauKultTour is a guided brewery tour of about 1.5 hours with a Zwickel tasting and a finish in the Zirbelstube above the city.
new.tip: Tickets from about 26 euro; 2026 dates ran into late November. No parking on site.

new.title: Start the day with breakfast at Café Zentral
new.desc: Café Zentral stands at the Südring edge of the Bermuda3Eck, opposite the junction with Brüderstraße, and is recommended in a university guide for breakfast.
new.tip: Go before the district's nightlife starts.

new.title: Have coffee and cake at Café Zwei Säulen
new.desc: Café Zwei Säulen on Hattinger Straße 796 carries a 4.8 rating from 242 reviews on Reviewhero.
new.tip: Check opening hours first; it lies on the road toward Stiepel.
new.q: Café Zwei Säulen, Hattinger Straße 796, Bochum

new.title: Go to Bochum Total in the Bermuda3Eck
new.desc: Bochum Total is a free open-air music festival in the Bermuda3Eck, with four main stages and no admission charge. The 2026 edition was the 40th and ran from 2 to 5 July.
new.tip: It is usually early July; no ticket needed.

new.title: Browse the Bochumer Weihnacht Christmas market
new.desc: The Bochumer Weihnacht fills the city centre each winter; the 2026 edition is listed for 19 November to 23 December. Earlier editions ran daily from 11:00 to 22:00.
new.tip: Check the official page for opening hours.

new.title: See a play at the Prinz Regent Theater
new.desc: The Prinz Regent Theater is an independent theatre founded in 1991 in a former mine building, with about 100 seats. It has no resident ensemble and hosts guest productions and festivals.
new.tip: Tickets 16 euro, reduced 8; card payments are not accepted.

new.title: Watch the sunset from the Tippelsberg
new.desc: The Tippelsberg is a 150 metre high former rubble heap with views up to 80 km on clear days. It draws crowds on New Year's Eve and for the Cranger Kirmes fireworks.
new.tip: Always open and free; some trees block certain viewpoints.

new.title: Join ExtraSchicht night at the Jahrhunderthalle
new.desc: ExtraSchicht, the Night of Industrial Culture, takes place at some 40 venues across the Ruhr in late June; the 2026 edition was on 27 June. Bochum's Jahrhunderthalle is one of the venues.
new.tip: A single ticket covers all venues and public transport in the VRR area that evening.

new.title: Drink in the Amsel beer garden near the Ruhr
new.desc: Ausflugsgaststätte Amsel in Schwerte lies among allotment gardens between the Ruhrtal cycle path and the Rohrmeisterei, about 200 m from the path, with a beer garden.
new.tip: A good stop on the Ruhrtalradweg.
new.q: Ausflugsgaststätte Amsel, Im Reiche des Wassers 11, Schwerte

new.title: Rest in the Haus Hohenstein beer garden in Witten
new.desc: Hotel Haus Hohenstein offers a beer garden after the last climb on the Ruhrtalradweg and has lockable garages for charging e-bikes.
new.tip: Open to cyclists; check opening times first.

new.title: Sit under the trees at Gasthof Kötter in Hamm
new.desc: Gasthof Kötter at Kleistraße 60 has a beer garden under shady trees serving German beers and hearty regional food.
new.tip: Summer evenings are best.

new.title: Eat in the Haus Liedke beer garden, Hamm
new.desc: Haus Liedke at Holzstraße 98 has a cosy beer garden with a large choice of beers and German wines plus regional dishes.
new.tip: Check opening hours first.

new.title: Eat at the Altes Brauhaus in Recklinghausen
new.desc: Altes Brauhaus at Dortmunder Straße 16 in Recklinghausen-Ost is a rustic restaurant serving German cuisine.
new.tip: Check recent reviews; few are listed.

new.title: Dine at Pfeiffer's Sythener Flora in Haltern
new.desc: Restaurant Pfeiffer's Sythener Flora in Haltern am See serves German cuisine at upper prices and holds 4.6 on OpenTable from 52 reviews.
new.tip: Reserve ahead.
new.q: Pfeiffer's Sythener Flora, Haltern am See

new.title: Sit in the Gaststätte Korte beer garden in Marl
new.desc: Gaststätte Korte at Halterner Straße 16 in Marl is listed as a summer beer garden.
new.tip: Evenings in summer.

new.title: Cruise the Hengsteysee on the MS Freiherr vom Stein
new.desc: Passenger boats on the Hengsteysee in Hagen run from a landing stage, with the MS Freiherr vom Stein. The season usually starts on Good Friday and ends around mid-October.
new.tip: Timetable on personenschifffahrt-hengsteysee.de.
new.q: Personenschifffahrt Hengsteysee Anleger, Dortmunder Straße, Hagen

new.title: Stroll the Nostalgic Christmas Market in Hattingen
new.desc: Hattingen holds a nostalgic Christmas market in its old town of half-timbered houses.
new.tip: Check the dates; it runs in the Advent weeks.

new.title: Walk up Halde Großes Holz in Bergkamen
new.desc: Halde Großes Holz in Bergkamen gives a far-reaching view over the eastern Ruhr area, and a light installation called Impulse sits at its summit.
new.tip: Free to visit; bring a jacket for the summit.
